notes.title: Get Free: Simple Story - Alex (Limited Time)
notes.content:
Covid-19 is raging in the world. And so many countries are in quarantine. People are sitting at home, someone is sick, someone has lost his job. All this is very sad and incomprehensible when it all ends. I decided to make one of my games free for a small amount of time and at the same time encourage other developers to do the same. Yes, we will lose some sales, but people will be able to stay at home and play games. If each developer makes at least one game free, then people can replenish the library with a rather large collection.

May God protect you all. Do not be ill. Your Creative.

notes.content:
The game was finally released! And so, we also released a new game trailer.

Everybody wants to get trading cards from the game, but this requires your support. To get cards implemented, we need to achive certain level of purchases, reviews, and other activities. I put my soul in this project, and I hope, what we will pass the line together, so I can add the cards, for your joy!
